verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs confirm support for multiple payout currencies, local payouts to avoid SWIFT fees, and configurable payout accounts (docs-13, docs-22, docs-12), directly addressing local-currency acceptance and home-currency settlement. However, there's no explicit evidence of transparent, itemized FX markup/rates, and community feedback highlights Adyen's interchange-plus pricing as opaque/complex compared to flat-rate competitors, plus integration and reserve requirement friction for smaller founders (adyen-comm-6, adyen-comm-7, adyen-comm-9).
